notes.title: And we're live!
notes.content:
It's been some time, but Hexaverse has evolved into something actually playable.
After years of trial and error, countless (mostly fixed) bugs, good and dumped features, we are now slowly approaching a release version of the game. There is still quite some room for improvement, possibly and hopefully with your involvement, but even as is, you might already enjoy it.

So give it a go if you feel up to the challenge and the strategic madness of this game ːsteamhappyː
